crossRefs.note: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
“I, Yahweh, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of…
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me…

translations.web: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
translations.bsb: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
translations.kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
translations.asv: I am perfect; I regard not myself; I despise my life.
